local out={} local P=game.Players.LocalPlayer
-- 1) 콘솔 오류 수와 첫 오류
local ok,hist=pcall(function() return game:GetService("LogService"):GetLogHistory() end)
local errs,first=0,""
if ok then for _,m in ipairs(hist) do if m.messageType==Enum.MessageType.MessageError then errs=errs+1 if first=="" then first=string.sub(m.message,1,160) end end end end
table.insert(out,"HEALTH_ERR n="..errs.." first="..first)
-- 2) 화면 이미지 자산 불러오기 실패
local gui=P:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") local t,seen={},{}
if gui then for _,d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton") then local i=d.Image if type(i)=="string" and string.find(i,"rbxassetid://",1,true) and not seen[i] then seen[i]=true table.insert(t,d) end end end end
local failed={}
pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(t,function(id,st) if st==Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Failure or st==Enum.AssetFetchStatus.TimedOut then if #failed<20 then table.insert(failed,id) end end end) end)
table.insert(out,"HEALTH_ASSET fail="..#failed.." total="..#t.." ids="..table.concat(failed,","))
-- 3) 월드: 몹(플레이어 아닌 Humanoid)과 체력, 지형 부품 수
local mobs,hpsum,parts=0,0,0
for _,d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
 if d:IsA("Humanoid") and not game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(d.Parent) then mobs=mobs+1 hpsum=hpsum+d.Health elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then parts=parts+1 end
end
table.insert(out,"HEALTH_WORLD mobs="..mobs.." mobhp="..math.floor(hpsum).." parts="..parts)
-- 4) 퀘스트·전투 UI 글자가 화면에 있는지(없으면 UI 연결 의심)
local words={"퀘스트","항해","교역","백과"} local found={}
if gui then for _,d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) and d.Text~="" then for _,w in ipairs(words) do if string.find(d.Text,w,1,true) then found[w]=(found[w] or 0)+1 end end end end end
local parts2={} for _,w in ipairs(words) do table.insert(parts2,w.."="..(found[w] or 0)) end
table.insert(out,"HEALTH_UI "..table.concat(parts2," "))
-- 5) 조명/배경
local L=game:GetService("Lighting")
table.insert(out,"HEALTH_LIGHT clock="..string.format("%.1f",L.ClockTime).." bright="..string.format("%.2f",L.Brightness).." atmos="..tostring(L:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")~=nil).." sky="..tostring(L:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")~=nil))
return table.concat(out,"\n")
